parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate how the volume of water affects the rate at which hot water in a beaker cools. Refer to Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Pour 200 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker. Use the graduations on the beaker as a guide. Place the thermometer in the water. In the first row of Table 2.1, record the temperature θ of the water at time t = 0 and immediately start the stop-watch. Record the temperature θ of the water at times t = 30 s, 60 s, 90 s, 120 s, 150 s and 180 s. Remove the thermometer from the beaker and pour out the water. [1]
